title: fs-dir: crypto operations (wp11_backend_fs_dir.c)
description: Implement src/wp11_backend_fs_dir.c: the wp11_backend_ops_t vtable for the fs-dir backend (sign, verify, decrypt). Mirrors wp11_backend_usb_flash.c — loads key material from the slot's .p11k keystore entry and delegates to wolfCrypt. ~300 lines. Depends on the header bead.
